blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Colbert, yeah. I haven't seen him. I don't think I've ever met him.
They all come from down there. He's Pete de Conje and all them. Albert de Conje, all the on there.
I knew Albert de Conje and he's Dolph de Conje. I knew all them.
I don't know what he is but I don't see him anymore.
I think Pete has a bar up north or something.
Yeah. He stood over the waters a long time.
